description: Source code for PHPMailer SMTP transport class implementing RFC 821 commands, including connection management, SMTP extensions, authentication, and message transmission.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: Class implementing SMTP protocol commands, connection handling, authentication, and message transmission for PHPMailer.

methods.name: edebug
methods.description: Outputs debugging information based on debug level and output method.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to SMTP server with specified host, port, timeout, and options.

methods.name: getSMTPConnection
methods.description: Creates socket connection to SMTP server, with fallback to fsockopen.

methods.name: startTLS
methods.description: Initiates TLS encryption on the SMTP connection.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication with username, password, and specified auth type.

methods.name: hmac
methods.description: Calculates MD5 HMAC hash, with fallback implementation if hash_hmac is unavailable.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the SMTP connection is active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes SMTP socket connection and resets state.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Sends message data via SMTP DATA command, handling line breaks and dot-stuffing.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Sends HELO or EHLO command to identify client to server.

methods.name: sendHello
methods.description: Low-level implementation of HELO/EHLO command, parses server response.

methods.name: parseHelloFields
methods.description: Parses server response to EHLO/HELO to discover extensions.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Sends MAIL FROM command with sender address.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Sends QUIT command and closes connection.

methods.name: recipient
methods.description: Sends RCPT TO command for recipient address, with optional DSN notifications.

methods.name: xclient
methods.description: Sends XCLIENT command with specified attributes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Sends RSET command to abort current transaction.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends SMTP command and checks for expected reply codes.

methods.name: sendAndMail
methods.description: Sends SAML command to start mail transaction.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Sends VRFY command to verify email address.

methods.name: noop
methods.description: Sends NOOP command to keep connection alive.

methods.name: turn
methods.description: Placeholder for TURN command, not implemented.

methods.name: client_send
methods.description: Sends raw data to SMTP server, with debug output.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns last SMTP error information.

methods.name: getServerExtList
methods.description: Returns list of SMTP extensions supported by server.

methods.name: getServerExt
methods.description: Returns specific SMTP extension info or server name.

methods.name: getLastReply
methods.description: Returns last reply string from server.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Reads response lines from SMTP server, handling timeouts and multi-line responses.

methods.name: setVerp
methods.description: Enables or disables VERP address generation.

methods.name: getVerp
methods.description: Returns current VERP mode.

methods.name: setSMTPUTF8
methods.description: Enables or disables SMTPUTF8 support.

methods.name: getSMTPUTF8
methods.description: Returns current SMTPUTF8 mode.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets error message and codes.

methods.name: setDebugOutput
methods.description: Sets method for debug output.

methods.name: getDebugOutput
methods.description: Returns current debug output method.

methods.name: setDebugLevel
methods.description: Sets debug level.

methods.name: getDebugLevel
methods.description: Returns current debug level.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets SMTP connection timeout.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns current SMTP timeout.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Handles PHP errors during socket operations, sets error info.

methods.name: recordLastTransactionID
methods.description: Extracts SMTP transaction ID from last reply using regex patterns.

methods.name: getLastTransactionID
methods.description: Returns last SMTP transaction ID.
